topics.title: Meta settlement adds teen limits
topics.summary: Meta agreed to a major settlement over teen safety claims, adding default limits and overnight blocks for young Facebook and Instagram users if the court-approved deal takes effect.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the studio made a social app for teens, what one rule would feel helpful instead of annoying?

topics.title: Plug-in solar reaches UK homes
topics.summary: Plug-in solar panel kits are going on sale in Britain, aimed at renters and households without rooftops, with officials saying they could trim power bills.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would everyone trust a balcony solar setup, or would someone immediately start calculating the snack-fridge savings?

topics.title: Yayoi Kusama remembered worldwide
topics.summary: Japanese artist Yayoi Kusama, famous for polka dots, pumpkins and immersive infinity rooms, died at 97, prompting global tributes to her long creative career.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the studio built a Kusama-inspired room, would it be peaceful, dizzying, or secretly perfect for a sitcom argument?

topics.title: Methane scanner goes mobile
topics.summary: Researchers reported a vehicle-mounted spectroscopy system that can detect methane while driving, potentially helping crews find hidden leaks across wide areas faster.
topics.discussionPrompt: Who in the studio would turn a leak-detecting science van into a neighborhood mystery mission?
